description: Wipe a gameserver now (games with a wipe such as Rust): kind map, blueprints or full. Backs up first unless backupFirst=false. Irreversible for the wiped data: state the effect and get an explicit yes first. Returns an operation (poll get_operation_status). For a recurring wipe use create_gameserver_schedule with action=wipe. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

seed.description: Map seed: "keep" (default), "random" or a fixed number.

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: wipe_gameserver
title: Wipe Game Server
